CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE emp_info
(
department VARCHAR(200),
joining_date date,
salary INT,
bonus_amount int,
city VARCHAR(50)

)
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'clinicaltri-bronze/bronze/emprun1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsy01_file,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
);

-- CREATE schema landing;
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE landing.emp_info
WITH(
     LOCATION = 'synapse-file/landing/emp_info',
     data_source = DS_stsynap_file_data,
     FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
)AS
select *, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as landing_date from dbo.emp_info

select * from landing.emp_info;

-- drop EXTERNAL TABLE landing.emp_info


CREATE schema bronze;
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.emp_info
WITH(
     LOCATION = 'synapse-file/bronze/emp_info',
     data_source = DS_stsynap_file_data,
     FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
)AS
select UPPER(trim(department)) as department, CAST(joining_date as date) as joining_date,salary,bonus_amount,UPPER(trim(city)) as CITY
from dbo.emp_info


select * from bronze.emp_info
